name: CHIRAG DUHAN
bio:
Career Overview: Playing Style: A tall (6’4”), aggressive player with a powerful serve, fluid groundstrokes, and a knack for clutch performances, effective on hard courts.
Best Grand Slam Singles Performance: Yet to play in a senior Grand Slam main draw; reached R2 at 2022 Australian Open Juniors.
Notable Achievements: ITF Titles: Won 2 ITF Futures singles titles (2024 M15 Nakhon Si Thammarat, 2025 M15 Monastir). Biggest Singles Win: Defeated World No. 512 Siddhant Banthia at the 2024 ITF M15 Monastir SF. Junior Success: Achieved a career-high ITF Junior Ranking of #75 (2021), won three ITF J4 titles in 2021, and secured the 2021 Tennishub-MPTA National Junior U-18 title. Davis Cup & National Representation: Represented India at the 2018 Asian Oceania World Junior Cup.
Other Highlights: Trains at the Grow Tennis Academy in Delhi under Gaurav Sharma. Played qualifiers at the 2025 Delhi Open Challenger. Known for a 6-0, 6-0 rout of Yugraj Singh at the 2021 National Juniors. Aims for a Top 500 breakthrough by 2026.
Chirag is a promising talent in Indian tennis, transitioning from a strong junior career to the pro circuit. 🎾🇮🇳
